name: GEM Benchmark
description: GEM is a living benchmark for natural language generation (NLG) that provides a wide set of tasks and evaluation strategies to measure progress in NLG. It aims to address limitations of existing anglo-centric corpora and flawed metrics by supporting multilingual evaluation and evolving alongside new models.
reputation: GEM is a well-known living benchmark in the NLG community and is widely used for multilingual and multi-task generation evaluation.
notes: Designed as a living benchmark with regular updates to support multilingual NLG evaluation.
